label: Qur'an-primary research profile
purpose: Source-scoped analytical candidate generation for Asma research
source_policy: Only locally present passages whose per-passage rights explicitly permit the intended analysis may be processed. This profile does not authorize fetching, copying, publishing, or deriving records from other passages or editions.
method_policy: Every candidate must record a named, versioned analysis method and exact source passage, edition, hash, evidence, and term offsets.
candidate_policy: Candidates are reviewable analytical hypotheses, never canonical facts or revelation claims.

historical_metrics.note: Historical Asma counts remain unreconciled and are not used as extraction targets or acceptance thresholds.
